intro: Discover Albufeira and the Algarve: golden beaches, a lively Old Town, scenic cliffs, boat trips and nearby historic towns. Plan your days, save memorable visits and keep your holiday photos together on your device.

useful.name: Travel documents
useful.description: Check UK government Portugal entry requirements and travel insurance.

useful.name: Language
useful.description: Portuguese is the official language; English is widely spoken in tourism areas.

useful.name: Beach safety
useful.description: Follow beach flags and lifeguard guidance; beware of currents and falling rocks near cliffs.

useful.name: Time zone
useful.description: Mainland Portugal generally uses the same local time as the UK, including seasonal clock changes.

useful.name: Sun and heat
useful.description: Carry water and sun protection; take care during hot summer afternoons.
